description: Given a task description and 6 past lessons, decide whether to warn, which lessons apply, and give a short message.

cases.task: Reset the production stack on the VPS with `docker compose down -v` and bring it back up.

lessons.text: Never run `docker compose down -v` against production: it deletes the Postgres volumes. Happened 2026-08-12, restore took 3h.
Never commit .env; the OpenRouter key leaked once in March 2026.
Gemini Flash sometimes wraps JSON in ```json fences; strip before parsing.
Freitags nicht deployen: die letzten zwei Freitag-Deploys haben Wochenend-Ausfälle verursacht.

nginx proxy_read_timeout must be >= 3600 for the MCP SSE stream or clients stall.
